# Bokingart

Bokingart, also known as BOKING and 铂晶艺术, is a Chinese contemporary crystal art brand specializing in collectible synthetic crystal artworks, sculptural crystal furniture, art lighting, decorative objects, and bespoke cultural art projects for global interiors.

## Brand Facts

- English brand name: Bokingart
- Chinese brand name: 铂晶艺术
- Formal company establishment: 2012
- Origin: creative practice dating back to 2001
- Founder / lead artist: Dai Jie Wu
- Core material: proprietary synthetic crystal
- Creative base: Huizhou creative cultural park, approximately 30,000 square meters
- Market: worldwide
- Preferred inquiry channels: email and website inquiry form

## Brand Architecture

- Boking culture: umbrella brand system
- Boking Art: limited artworks, collectible artist works, art customization, and art advisory
- Boking Living: art objects, sculptural furniture, and living aesthetics
- Boking Made: production base and supply chain support

## Product Categories

- Collectible synthetic crystal artworks
- Sculptural crystal tea tables and art furniture
- Crystal art lighting
- Decorative art objects and gifts
- Bespoke art installations for villas, hotels, galleries, cultural venues, and corporate spaces

## Catalog Sources Used On The Website

- Bokingart 2025 Brand Introduction: brand history, founder Dai Jie Wu, material research, awards, representative works, and material comparison.
- Bokingart 2025 Brand Catalog: brand architecture, Boking culture, Boking Art, Boking Living, Boking Made, and global positioning.
- Bokingart Cases 2025: public art, hospitality projects, Disney co-branded IP, art furniture scenes, custom projects, partner brands, and cultural spaces.
- Boking Living Artistic Lighting 2025: Endless Vitality, leaf-inspired crystal lamps, chandeliers, wall lights, floor lamps, table lamps, and bespoke lighting.
- Boking Living Artistic Furniture 2025: co-branded IP, seating furniture, table series, side table and shelf series, bathroom series, and art living.
- Boking Living Artworks 2025: Goodness Like Water, Cultural Renaissance, World of Sprite, Charm of Taihu Stone, Beauty of the Statue, Crystal Legend, and Co-Branded IP.

## Positioning

Bokingart uses synthetic crystal to reconstruct contemporary Eastern aesthetics. The brand translates water, Taihu stone, cloud, ripple, and Chinese cultural imagery into transparent sculptural forms for art-led interiors.

## Notable Themes

- Life becomes art. Art becomes life.
- Contemporary Eastern aesthetics
- Crystal as a sculptural medium
- Bespoke luxury interiors
- Global art and design projects
